arms.text:
Root cause: deployment `url-shorten-mongodb` in namespace `social-network`.
Mechanism: ConfigMap url-shorten-mongodb key mongod.conf: net: ⏎ tls: ⏎ mode: requireTLS ⏎ certificateKeyFile: /etc/tls/tls.pem ⏎.
How it fails: configmap url-shorten-mongodb was changed recently and breaks deployment/url-shorten-mongodb, which it acts on.
Concrete details: ConfigMap url-shorten-mongodb was modified 134s ago, 10s after it was created; 2s before the first active symptom.
Observed impact: deployment `url-shorten-mongodb` in namespace `social-network`.
Fault type: config value (a wrong, missing, or shadowed value in this component's own configuration).
Fault object: configmap `url-shorten-mongodb` in namespace `social-network`.
Evidence:
- ConfigMap url-shorten-mongodb was modified 134s ago, 10s after it was created; 2s before the first active symptom
- deployment/url-shorten-mongodb: only 0 of 1 desired replicas are ready
